Evidence

components.name: Calendar event
components.description: Timed event with separate details and client-preparation buttons; quiet category fills and a Type fact identify client/internal/focus/personal commitments. The next client meeting is solid blue and repeated in a next-meeting strip. Only client meetings offer briefs.
components.css: .ds-calendar-event {display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:180px;min-height:92px;border:1px solid #ced9fb;border-radius:5px;background:#eef3ff;color:#244baf;overflow:hidden;font-family:var(--font, "DM Sans", sans-serif);} .ds-calendar-body {display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:3px;flex:1;padding:7px 8px 3px;text-align:left;color:inherit;background:transparent;border:0;font:inherit;cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden;} .ds-calendar-body strong {font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.25;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;max-width:100%;} .ds-calendar-time {font-size:10px;line-height:1.3;} .ds-calendar-topic {font-size:11px;line-height:1.3;max-width:100%;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;} .ds-calendar-link {display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;background:none;border:0;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;width:100%;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;padding:3px 8px 6px;line-height:1.3;} .ds-calendar-link:hover {text-decoration:underline;} .ds-calendar-event.ds-calendar-internal {background:#f2effa;border-color:#ded6ee;color:#62418a;} .ds-calendar-event.ds-calendar-focus {background:#f3f5f8;border-color:#e0e4ea;color:#566073;} .ds-calendar-event.ds-calendar-personal {background:#fafbfc;border-color:#e1e5ec;color:#657083;} .ds-calendar-event.ds-calendar-next {background:var(--accent, #3563e9);border-color:var(--accent, #3563e9);color:white;} .ds-calendar-event:hover {filter:brightness(.97);border-color:var(--accent, #3563e9);} .ds-calendar-event button:focus-visible {outline:2px solid var(--accent, #3563e9);outline-offset:3px;} @media(max-width:768px) {.ds-calendar-body strong {font-size:12px;} .ds-calendar-link {font-size:11px;padding-bottom:7px;}}

components.name: Meeting-ready notice
components.description: One automatic native ready modal per page visit announces a retained brief and offers Later or View meeting prep; other items remain discoverable through the unread control and Meeting Prep. Readiness does not imply review.
components.html:
Your brief for the Garcia family is ready

Quarterly reviewMonday · 2:00 PM · New York

Your client context, portfolio snapshot and discussion priorities are prepared for this meeting.
components.css: .ds-ready-notice {width:460px;max-width:calc(100% - 60px);padding:30px;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface, #fff);color:var(--text, #1a1f2e);box-shadow:0 18px 60px #18213726;font-family:var(--font, "DM Sans", sans-serif);} .ds-ready-notice h2 {font-size:23px;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.02em;max-width:350px;margin:0;} .ds-ready-appointment {display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;margin:20px 0;padding:14px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border-subtle, #ebedf1);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle, #ebedf1);} .ds-ready-appointment strong {font-size:13px;} .ds-ready-appointment span {font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-3, #6b7280);line-height:1.6;} .ds-ready-notice p {font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--text-2, #3d4556);} .ds-ready-actions {display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;margin-top:26px;flex-wrap:wrap;} .ds-ready-actions button {font:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;min-height:38px;padding:8px 13px;border:1px solid var(--border, #e2e5ea);border-radius:var(--radius-sm, 6px);background:var(--surface, #fff);color:var(--text-2, #3d4556);cursor:pointer;} .ds-ready-actions button:hover {background:var(--surface-hover, #f0f2f5);} .ds-ready-actions .ds-ready-primary {background:var(--accent, #3563e9);border-color:var(--accent, #3563e9);color:white;} .ds-ready-actions .ds-ready-primary:hover {background:#2c52c5;} .ds-ready-actions button:focus-visible {outline:2px solid var(--accent, #3563e9);outline-offset:3px;}

narrative.overview: The existing advisor dashboard is a compact working interface: DM Sans, white cards on a cool gray canvas, fine borders and blue actions. Meeting Prep extends this vocabulary inside the current sidebar and topbar. Its brief reads as a structured document, with evidence kept alongside the text.
keyCharacteristics: White surfaces separated by subtle borders.
Blue actions, navigation selection and source references.
Visible draft, review and synthetic-data states.

rules.name: The Blue Action Rule
rules.body: Use blue for actionable emphasis and selection; reserve semantic colors for status and categorization.

rules.name: The Compact Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy through weight, spacing and a restrained size ramp; keep the brief in the existing DM Sans family.

rules.name: The Bordered Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate resting surfaces with neutral fills and fine borders; reserve the incumbent hover shadow for interactive client cards.

dos: Do preserve the current sidebar, topbar, DM Sans family and compact dashboard density.
Do keep source references next to the claims they support and show the selected original record in the evidence area.
Do keep draft/review text, advisor-edit attribution, synthetic-data labels and export state visible.
Do let action groups wrap and stack the brief and evidence on narrower screens.
donts: Don't introduce a new display face, decorative hero treatment or replacement visual concept for this extension.
Don't apply client-card hover elevation to every resting card.
Don't indicate review status or errors through color alone.
